capabilities.name: Room database
capabilities.summary: Local relational storage with entities, DAOs exposing Flow, Hilt-provided database, migrations and an in-memory DAO test.

capabilities.name: DataStore preferences
capabilities.summary: Typed user settings on Preferences DataStore with a Flow-backed repository, atomic edits and a JVM test.

capabilities.name: Retrofit networking
capabilities.summary: Retrofit + OkHttp + kotlinx.serialization with auth and logging interceptors, sealed error mapping and a MockWebServer test.

capabilities.name: Ktor client
capabilities.summary: Ktor HttpClient on the OkHttp engine with content negotiation, bearer auth refresh, error mapping and a MockEngine test; the Retrofit alternative.

capabilities.name: Hilt dependency injection
capabilities.summary: Dagger Hilt with KSP: application and entry points, binding modules, dispatcher qualifiers, hiltViewModel in navigation, WorkManager factory and a module-swapping test.

capabilities.name: Koin dependency injection
capabilities.summary: Koin module DSL, startKoin, koinViewModel in navigation, WorkManager factory and a verify() graph test; the no-codegen alternative to Hilt.

capabilities.name: WorkManager background work
capabilities.summary: Hilt-injected CoroutineWorker with one-time, periodic, expedited and foreground work, constraints, unique policies, status Flow and a worker test.

capabilities.name: Notifications
capabilities.summary: Channels, POST_NOTIFICATIONS runtime flow on API 33+, action receivers, grouping with a summary, deep-link tap intents and a UI Automator test.

capabilities.name: Deep links and App Links
capabilities.summary: Verified Android App Links with assetlinks.json, a custom-scheme fallback, a single untrusted-input parser and Navigation Compose typed deep links.

capabilities.name: Biometric unlock
capabilities.summary: androidx.biometric prompt with device-credential fallback and an Android Keystore AES key bound to user authentication, with re-lock on background.

capabilities.name: Credential Manager sign-in
capabilities.summary: One Credential Manager 1.6.0 flow for passkeys, saved passwords and Sign in with Google (googleid), passkey registration and sign-out.

capabilities.name: Firebase Authentication
capabilities.summary: Firebase Auth repository with current-user Flow, email/password and Google via Credential Manager, ID tokens for your API, and Auth emulator tests.

capabilities.name: Firebase Firestore
capabilities.summary: Firestore with offline persistence, a callbackFlow snapshot wrapper, server timestamps, pagination, a security-rules reminder and emulator tests.

capabilities.name: Firebase Cloud Messaging
capabilities.summary: FCM service for data messages and token rotation, token upload through WorkManager, topics, and a test send with the HTTP v1 API.

capabilities.name: Play Billing
capabilities.summary: Billing Library 9.0.0: BillingClient with reconnection, product details, purchase flow, server verification before acknowledgement, restore and license testing.

capabilities.name: Camera capture
capabilities.summary: CameraX 1.6.2 preview and photo capture in Compose with CameraXViewfinder, CAMERA permission, MediaStore output, flash and lens switching.

capabilities.name: Photo picker
capabilities.summary: PickVisualMedia and PickMultipleVisualMedia with no storage permission, copying picked media into app storage, and an Espresso Intents test.

capabilities.name: Image loading
capabilities.summary: Coil 3 AsyncImage with a singleton ImageLoader on the app's OkHttp client, memory and disk caches, placeholders, previews and a fake-engine test.

capabilities.name: Paging
capabilities.summary: Paging 3.5.1 with Room as source of truth and a RemoteMediator with remote keys, cachedIn, load-state UI in Compose and a mediator test.

capabilities.name: Maps
capabilities.summary: Google Maps with Maps Compose, API key injected by the Secrets Gradle plugin, camera state, clustering, my-location layer gated on permission and dark styling.

capabilities.name: Location
capabilities.summary: FusedLocationProviderClient current fix and update Flow, coarse-then-fine permission flow with rationale, background-location policy and emulator injection.

capabilities.name: Home screen widget
capabilities.summary: Jetpack Glance widget with responsive sizes, Hilt entry point for data, click and callback actions, updates from the app and a Glance unit test.

capabilities.name: App shortcuts
capabilities.summary: Static, dynamic and pinned launcher shortcuts via ShortcutManagerCompat, routed through the App Link parser, with usage reporting and a Robolectric test.

capabilities.name: In-app updates and review
capabilities.summary: Play In-App Updates (flexible and immediate) and In-App Review through the split Play Core libraries, with fake managers for tests and internal app sharing for device checks.

capabilities.name: Media playback
capabilities.summary: Media3 1.11.1 ExoPlayer in a MediaSessionService, MediaController repository, PlayerSurface in Compose, foreground media type and an asset playback test.

capabilities.name: On-device AI
capabilities.summary: ML Kit GenAI APIs on Gemini Nano via AICore with runtime availability checks, model download, streaming output and a consented Firebase AI Logic cloud fallback; device-gated.

capabilities.name: App icon
capabilities.summary: Adaptive launcher icon with foreground, background and monochrome layers for themed icons, legacy PNG fallback and a Robolectric layer check.

capabilities.name: Localization
capabilities.summary: String resources, plurals, locale-aware formatting, per-app language preferences on API 33+ with the AppCompat backport, RTL and pseudolocales.

capabilities.name: Settings screen
capabilities.summary: Material 3 settings screen in Compose backed by DataStore: switch, radio-dialog and navigation rows, a single UiState, theme applied at the root and a Compose test.

capabilities.name: Onboarding flow
capabilities.summary: HorizontalPager onboarding with indicators, skip/next, permission priming without requesting, completion in DataStore and flicker-free start destination.

capabilities.name: Splash screen
capabilities.summary: androidx.core.splashscreen with themed icon and background, installSplashScreen before onCreate, keep-on-screen tied to a root ViewModel and an exit animation.

capabilities.name: App startup and Baseline Profiles
capabilities.summary: App Startup initializers for ordered lazy init, a baselineprofile module with Macrobenchmark 1.5.0, a profile generator, startup benchmark and release packaging checks.

capabilities.name: Crash reporting
capabilities.summary: Firebase Crashlytics behind a CrashReporter interface, mapping upload, non-fatals with keys and breadcrumbs, consent toggle and a forced test crash.

capabilities.name: Analytics events
capabilities.summary: Firebase Analytics with a typed event catalog, consent mode defaults off in the manifest, screen tracking from Navigation Compose, DebugView verification and a recording fake.

capabilities.name: Network security config
capabilities.summary: Cleartext blocked, per-domain certificate pinning with backup pins and expiry, debug-only user CA trust, OkHttp CertificatePinner and tests that prove failures.

capabilities.name: Wear OS companion
capabilities.summary: Minimal :wear module with Compose for Wear OS and the Data Layer API syncing a small state object from the phone; runtime-unverified in this repository.

capabilities.name: Auto Backup and data extraction rules
capabilities.summary: fullBackupContent and dataExtractionRules excluding secrets, device ids and caches, secrets in noBackupFilesDir, restore detection and bmgr-based restore testing.

capabilities.name: Proto DataStore
capabilities.summary: Typed, schema-versioned preferences with Proto DataStore in a JVM proto module: protobuf plugin, Serializer, DataMigrations guarded by schema flags, Flow-backed repository, migration from Preferences DataStore and a JVM test.

capabilities.name: Offline-first sync
capabilities.summary: Change-list synchronization of Room tables: Synchronizer/Syncable contract, changeListSync helper with versions in Proto DataStore, a HiltWorker CoroutineWorker running repositories in parallel, SyncManager exposing isSyncing, conflict strategy and tests.

capabilities.name: Design system module
capabilities.summary: A :core:designsystem module with AppTheme (light, dark, dynamic), typography, shapes, an AppIcons object, Material 3 component wrappers, ThemePreviews and DevicePreviews annotations, and an :app-catalog application for reviewing components.

capabilities.name: NDK native code
capabilities.summary: C++ through CMake and JNI: externalNativeBuild, RegisterNatives in JNI_OnLoad, @JvmStatic external fun facade, version script, ABI filters, 16 KB page-size alignment, ndk-stack, Prefab, HWASan/UBSan build types and googletest on device.

capabilities.name: Oboe low-latency audio
capabilities.summary: Oboe through Prefab: a native AudioStream engine with a real-time data callback and reconnect on disconnect, device audio properties fed from Kotlin, a StateFlow repository, a Compose tone screen and the latency-tuning loop; runtime-unverified in this repository.

capabilities.name: Vulkan and GLES rendering
capabilities.summary: Choosing Activity + GLSurfaceView, GameActivity or NativeActivity, Vulkan versus OpenGL ES 3, surface lifecycle in C++, game-activity through Prefab with WHOLE_ARCHIVE, glslc shader compilation and a GLES renderer inside a Compose screen; runtime-unverified in this repository.

capabilities.name: Media session service
capabilities.summary: UAMP architecture on Media3 1.11.1: MediaLibraryService with ExoPlayer, browse tree for Android Auto and Automotive, caller allowlisting in onConnect, DefaultMediaNotificationProvider, playback resumption, MediaBrowser repository with a Compose browse screen and Cast via media3-cast.

capabilities.name: Rich text and Markdown
capabilities.summary: Paragraph model to AnnotatedString with bold, italic, code, LinkAnnotation URLs and clickable mentions, TextLinkStyles, inline content, bullets and code blocks in a LazyColumn, AnnotatedString.fromHtml, and a JVM parser test.

capabilities.name: Compose drawing and graphics
capabilities.summary: Canvas and draw modifiers, data-driven Path with drawWithCache, gradient Brush, graphicsLayer transforms without recomposition, scroll-provider lambdas, a custom Layout with a ParentDataModifier, and an AGSL shader Modifier.Node with a pre-API-33 fallback.

capabilities.name: TV and large-screen app
capabilities.summary: A :tv application module with androidx.tv Material on shared core modules: Leanback launcher manifest and banner, overscan margins, navigation drawer with focusProperties and focusGroup, catalog rows with focusRestorer, D-pad key handling on a custom seek bar, and TV emulator checks; runtime-unverified in this repository.
